title: AI Builders Digest
subtitle: Bilingual edition · 双语对照版

intro.text: 今天的 feed 像一张小而清晰的地图：个人 agent 正在把互联网推向一个基础设施问题，注意力危机也可能被进一步放大；与此同时，真正的企业护城河越来越像是那些长期积累、但过去被锁在系统里的数据。No Priors 对 EON 的访谈把这条线说得很具体：模型和算力的切换成本越来越低，数据才是更难替代的资产；而 agent 一旦拥有权限，安全问题也从‘人会不会误操作’变成了‘非人身份会做什么’。

archive.title: 数据护城河日报
archive.desc: 个人 agent 带来新的基础设施挑战，而企业的长期数据正在从沉睡资产变成 AI 时代真正的控制层与护城河。

footerNote: Source: Follow Builders curated daily digest. Rebuilt from the 2026-09-07 source feeds.

sections.title: Personal Agents Need a New Internet / 个人 Agent 需要新互联网
sections.desc: 当每个人都有 agent 替自己执行任务，变化首先会落在基础设施、体验和商业模式上。

rewrite: Box CEO Aaron Levie argues that the internet is almost entirely unprepared for a world where everyone's personal agents are running around executing tasks for them.
The opportunity is not limited to smarter assistants. It reaches down into infrastructure, user experience, and entirely new business models.
original: The internet is almost entirely unprepared for a future where everyone’s personal agents are running around executing tasks for them.
There are going to be endless new challenges and opportunities at the infrastructure layer, for user experiences, new business models, and more.

rewrite: Box CEO Aaron Levie 认为，互联网几乎完全没有准备好迎接这样一个世界：每个人的 personal agent 都在替自己到处执行任务。
机会不只是做出更聪明的助手，而是会一路下沉到基础设施、用户体验，以及全新的商业模式。
original: 互联网几乎完全没有准备好迎接每个人的 personal agent 到处替他们执行任务的未来。
基础设施层、用户体验、新商业模式等方向都会出现无穷的新挑战和机会。

sections.title: Attention Is the Constraint / 注意力才是约束
sections.desc: agent 让执行更便宜，但不一定让人更专注。

rewrite: Builder Zara Zhang points to a less technical bottleneck: the shortening of human attention spans may be one of the biggest crises of our time, and agents could make it worse.
original: One of the biggest crises of our time is the shortening of the human attention span

original: 我们这个时代最大的危机之一，是人类注意力持续缩短。

"this fix is the real deal"
Fable PM, Astra engineer is undefeated 🤝

sections.title: Data Becomes the Control Plane / 数据成为控制层
sections.desc: 企业 AI 的难题不只是模型，而是找到、理解、保护并激活已有数据。

rewrite: EON co-founders Ofir Ehrlich and Gonen Stein make the case that models and compute are increasingly replaceable, while a company's accumulated data is the harder-to-copy asset. The immediate challenge is that this data is scattered, expensive, poorly mapped, and often locked inside systems nobody fully understands.

Their proposed data foundation maps and classifies structured and unstructured data, adds context and access control, and connects it to AI workflows without casually exposing sensitive information. The security problem changes too: agents are non-human actors with legitimate permissions, so organizations need to assume breach and be able to detect and recover from destructive behavior at much higher velocity.
The memorable line is simple: ‘the most valuable thing that you have is actually your data.’
original: the most valuable thing that you have is actually your data.
Become a moat.
We need to assume breach, whether it's malicious or not, and need to be able to handle it and act accordingly.

rewrite: EON 联合创始人 Ofir Ehrlich 和 Gonen Stein 认为，模型和算力的可替代性越来越高，而一家公司长期积累的数据才是更难复制的资产。眼下的问题是，这些数据分散、昂贵、缺少清晰的映射，而且常常锁在没人完全理解的老系统里。
他们提出的数据底座会对结构化和非结构化数据做映射、分类，补上上下文和访问控制，再接入 AI workflow，同时避免敏感信息被随意暴露。安全问题也变了：agent 是拥有合法权限的非人类行为者，组织需要假设 breach 可能发生，并能以更高速度检测和恢复破坏性行为。
最值得记住的一句话很简单：‘你真正拥有的最有价值的东西，其实就是你的数据。’
original: 你真正拥有的最有价值的东西，其实就是你的数据。
让它成为护城河。
我们需要假设 breach 会发生，无论它是恶意的还是非恶意的，并做好处理和应对。
